title: Reference into the Box
prompt_md:
## Goal
Define a `Box` class that stores one private integer and hands callers a *reference* to it, so they can read and modify the member directly through the returned reference.

## Input
Three integers on one line: a starting value, an amount to add, and an amount to subtract.

## Output
One line: the final stored value (start + add - subtract).

## Feature
This exercises a member function that returns a non-`const` reference to a data member. The driver writes to the member by assigning through the returned reference (`box.value() = ...`) and modifies it in place (`+=`, `-=`); your accessor only works if it returns a true reference that aliases the member rather than a copy.

title: Editable Label Text
prompt_md:
## Goal
Define a `Label` class that holds a private `std::string`. Expose it two ways: a `const`-reference getter for read-only access, and a non-`const`-reference accessor that lets callers modify the string in place.

## Input
Two words separated by a space: a base string and a suffix to append.

## Output
One line: the base string with the suffix appended directly onto it.

## Feature
This exercises member functions that return references to a data member in both flavors. The read path returns `const std::string&` (no copy, read-only); the write path returns `std::string&`, and the driver only produces the right answer if that reference genuinely aliases the stored member.
